column1: 線描與素描|Drawing & draftsmanship|graphite|石墨明暗素描|Graphite value study|硬鉛筆畫結構，軟鉛筆疊出中灰，保留紙面亮部|build structure in hard graphite, layer soft graphite down to velvety middle values, and reserve white paper for highlights|用柔擦拉開高光旁的灰階，不抹平輪廓|lift graphite with an eraser beside bright contours rather than smudging the entire outline|觀察練習與體積研究

線描與素描|Drawing & draftsmanship|charcoal|炭筆塊面|Charcoal mass drawing|以炭條側面鋪大灰塊，將形體歸納為少數明暗塊|block in large gray shapes with the side of vine charcoal and simplify form to a few value masses|用壓縮炭筆加深接觸陰影，讓其他邊緣斷續|reinforce contact shadows with compressed charcoal and let less important edges break away|戲劇光與剪影草圖

線描與素描|Drawing & draftsmanship|crosshatch|鋼筆交叉排線|Pen and crosshatch|墨線隨體積轉折，排線交角決定明暗|turn pen strokes around the volume and control shade with the angle and density of crosshatching|保留足夠空隙，使陰影不是一整塊黑|leave gaps between lines so shadow never becomes one flat black patch|小尺幅書籍插畫

線描與素描|Drawing & draftsmanship|stippling|墨點塑形|Ink stipple study|用疏密不同的獨立墨點建立平滑明暗，避免線性排筆|model smooth values with isolated black ink dots of different densities without hatching|局部放大點距變化，在主體邊緣刻意維持乾淨|make dot spacing legible near the focal plane and keep the primary silhouette clean|自然筆記與單色印刷

線描與素描|Drawing & draftsmanship|contour|單線輪廓|Continuous contour drawing|以不間斷的單線穿過輪廓和內部接點|guide one continuous line through outer contours and internal junctions|用停頓與細微線寬暗示重心，不用填黑|suggest weight with deliberate pauses and subtle line width, never filled black|極簡圖像與動態寫生

線描與素描|Drawing & draftsmanship|sanguine|紅堊紙上速寫|Red-chalk sheet study|在暖灰紙上用紅堊描出中間調與壓實紅褐陰影|use red chalk on warm gray paper for midtones and compressed russet shadows|用白堊點出紙面以上的亮部，留筆痕|raise only the highest lights with white chalk and retain grain|復古素描與表面研究

水性媒材|Water-based painting|water-wet|濕畫法水彩|Wet-in-wet watercolor|先潤紙，再滴入顏料，讓色塊沿水膜自然相融|pre-wet the sheet and let drops of pigment spread through a continuous wash|最後用少量乾筆讓視線停在主體|finish with a few dry accents to anchor the subject|氣氛、薄霧與光色

水性媒材|Water-based painting|water-dry|乾筆水彩|Drybrush watercolor|用含水量低的顏料掃過粗紙，留下細碎露白與礦物顏料顆粒|drag nearly dry pigment across rough paper, exposing tiny specks of white and mineral granulation|在焦點補一片透明洗色，不把紙紋塗死|place one transparent glaze at the focus without filling the paper tooth|石材、樹皮與細節質地

水性媒材|Water-based painting|gouache|不透明塊面水粉|Opaque gouache blocks|霧面水粉以整片純色覆蓋，控制邊線鋒利或柔化的節奏|lay down matte opaque gouache as uninterrupted color planes with rhythmic hard and soft edges|只用少數亮色收尾，避免數位式連續漸層|finish with a handful of light accents rather than continuous digital gradients|封面圖與色塊插畫

水性媒材|Water-based painting|ink-wash|水墨濃淡|Graded ink wash|用一筆內墨濃水淡的變化，構成墨暈、留白和乾筆|build dark-to-light ink within individual strokes using blooms, reserved paper and dry marks|將遠層降到稀墨，讓近景筆勢乾脆|dilute the distant layer and preserve decisive near strokes|留白構圖與單色景物

水性媒材|Water-based painting|tempera|蛋彩細筆|Egg tempera hatching|細筆交疊薄蛋彩，建立光潔而不反光的表面|cross thin smooth egg-tempera strokes into a lucid but non-glossy surface|色層順著形體走向，避免厚堆顏料|follow form with the small layered marks and avoid raised paint|細密板上畫與工整插畫

水性媒材|Water-based painting|acrylic-glaze|丙烯薄罩染|Acrylic glaze layers|用透明壓克力疊加清透色膜，讓底層透出|apply clear acrylic glazes so the underpainting shows through transparent films|可見疊色處加深，不用霧化濾鏡|deepen intersections of glazes while avoiding foggy filters|半透明材質與高色彩層次

油畫與粉材|Oil, wax & pastel|impasto|厚塗刮刀|Palette-knife impasto|刮刀厚堆顏料並留下斷續刀痕和凸起高光|build ridged thick paint with a palette knife, leaving fractured strokes and raised highlights|厚度集中在受光表面，暗面僅薄刮|concentrate paint relief in illuminated planes and scrape the shadows thin|具觸感的近看與戲劇光

油畫與粉材|Oil, wax & pastel|oil-glaze|油畫分層罩染|Layered oil glazing|冷色底畫乾後罩上暖透明色，層層保留深處光澤|glaze transparent warm oil over a dry cool underpainting while preserving inner luminosity|用少量不透明色拉開亮部，背景維持深透|contrast with a few opaque highlights while keeping the background translucent|低調光與精細靜物

油畫與粉材|Oil, wax & pastel|alla-prima|濕上濕直畫油彩|Alla prima oil|把濕顏料畫在尚未乾的前一筆上，保留自然混色邊|paint fresh oil directly into still-wet marks and keep naturally mixed edges|受光處顏色一筆定型，不反覆打磨|place the illuminated color in one confident stroke rather than polishing it|戶外感、快速顏色筆記

油畫與粉材|Oil, wax & pastel|soft-pastel|軟粉彩層疊|Layered soft pastel|用軟粉條側掃並層疊互補色，留下粉末和紙紋|side-sweep soft pastel and stack complementary dust layers with visible paper tooth|焦點用碎粉點亮，周圍以疏筆銜接|light the focal edge with small pastel crumbs and bridge it with sparse surrounding marks|柔霧、霧面與色粉粒感

油畫與粉材|Oil, wax & pastel|wax|融蠟彩繪|Encaustic wax painting|以分層融蠟封住顏料，每層可見半透明深度與刮刻線|suspend pigment in layered encaustic wax with translucent depth and shallow scratched lines|磨亮少數蠟面，在其他位置保留冷霧感|buff only a few wax surfaces and leave the rest softly cloudy|琥珀質感與分層抽象

油畫與粉材|Oil, wax & pastel|pointillism|分色點描|Divided-color pointillism|以分離的小色點並置互補色，遠看產生視覺混色|juxtapose complementary pigments as distinctly separate small dabs for optical mixing|在焦點收小色點，在背景放大點距|tighten dot size at focus and increase spacing in the background|躍動色光與可見色點

版畫與印製|Printmaking & reproduction|woodcut|木刻陰陽|Woodcut relief|順木紋刻出筆畫與空白，高對比印出凸面墨色|cut strokes and gaps along woodgrain, printing contrasting raised ink shapes|留下少數刀口毛邊，不加照片式灰階|leave occasional carved chatter and avoid photographic grays|鮮明剪影與版畫海報

版畫與印製|Printmaking & reproduction|linocut|油氈減版印|Reduction linocut|以同一塊板逐次挖除，讓三色依淺到深疊印|remove areas of one block in stages and overprint three inks light to dark|允許細微套色偏差，但重要輪廓可辨|allow subtle registration drift while keeping key outlines legible|限色插畫、視覺識別

版畫與印製|Printmaking & reproduction|etching|蝕刻凹版|Intaglio etching|酸蝕般的細槽裝墨，壓成沉入紙內的纖細線條|press ink from acid-bitten fine grooves into damp paper for recessed wiry lines|加少許版面薄墨，保留清楚的壓痕邊|include a little wiped plate tone and a visible plate impression|精細線條與古典紙本

版畫與印製|Printmaking & reproduction|screenprint|網版平印|Flat screen print|用遮模將少量高飽和油墨擠過網面，形成平坦色島|push a small set of saturated inks through stencil mesh into flat color islands|讓大色面乾淨，交疊位置才出現混色|keep broad color shapes pure and show mixing only at overlaps|海報、服飾圖案

版畫與印製|Printmaking & reproduction|risograph|孔版雙色印|Two-ink duplicator print|以兩色大豆油墨感疊色，半色調網點與疏鬆紙纖維可見|overprint two soy-ink-like colors with visible halftones and loose paper fibers|主輪廓允許輕微網版錯位，讓套印關係可讀|allow small registration shifts so the layer order remains clear|獨立刊物與贈品

版畫與印製|Printmaking & reproduction|monotype|單版擦拭|Wiped monotype|從上墨平板壓出一次性墨痕，以擦除而非描線製造光|lift one impression from an inked plate and create light by wiping rather than drawing lines|保留幽靈重影和薄墨漂浮的過渡|retain ghost impressions and floating thin-to-thick transitions|抽象、單件印畫

紙材與手作|Paper & craft|papercut|剪紙透空|Cut-paper silhouette|把紙面剪成相互承托的廓形，透空形成負形|cut interlocking paper silhouettes with negative spaces acting as design forms|窄橋接點保持紙材連續，邊緣乾脆|bridge narrow connections so the sheet remains structurally plausible; keep edges crisp|圖標與裝飾構圖

紙材與手作|Paper & craft|layered-paper|層紙浮雕|Layered cardstock relief|用不同厚度紙層堆疊，讓貼邊投下短而細的陰影|stack different cardstock thicknesses and let glued edges cast short narrow shadows|讓色層與真實深度清楚分離，不用假空氣透視|separate color planes from real layer depth rather than adding false aerial haze|立體插畫與紙模

紙材與手作|Paper & craft|torn-collage|手撕纖維拼貼|Torn-fiber collage|撕出粗糙紙邊，拼接紋理、方向和不等寬重疊|assemble torn paper with rough fiber edges, mismatched texture direction and irregular overlaps|刻意露出底紙作為第三種形狀|leave backing paper exposed as a third kind of shape|書封、感性材質關係

紙材與手作|Paper & craft|embroidered|繡線圖像|Embroidered illustration|以平針、緞面針和結粒組出圖像，線向跟隨形體|build the image with running stitches, satin fills and knots following the form|保留布縫隙及纖維高光，不畫成塑膠|retain the weave gaps and thread highlights rather than plastic surfaces|布章、手作角色與工藝感

紙材與手作|Paper & craft|tile-mosaic|碎片鑲嵌|Tessera mosaic|用尺寸不一的石片沿形體鋪排，細漿縫保持可見|lay irregular stone tesserae around forms with legible narrow grout lines|光線讓表面有微微落差，避免整齊像素網格|let light reveal slight differences in tile depth and avoid a rigid pixel grid|牆面、色塊與裝飾畫

紙材與手作|Paper & craft|cyanotype|藍曬接觸印|Cyanotype contact print|物件與感光紙貼合，日曬後留下普魯士藍底與白影|press objects against sensitized paper to leave white impressions in a Prussian-blue exposure|半透明材質以淡藍邊呈現，不加入額外色相|register translucent material with pale blue fringes and keep other hues absent|物件痕跡、標本與剪影

圖形與裝飾|Graphic & decorative art|flat-vector|平面幾何向量|Flat vector geometry|以精準封閉路徑拼成乾淨幾何形，控制負空間比例|construct clean geometric forms from precise closed paths and balance negative space|少量帶對比的小形服務視覺層級，不用材質|use a few contrasting minor shapes for hierarchy and omit surface texture|圖形識別與資訊插圖

圖形與裝飾|Graphic & decorative art|art-nouveau|曲線裝飾框|Botanical whiplash ornament|用植物般彎曲細線將邊框和主體連成一體|interlace the subject and border with botanical whiplash curves|密集細部只沿邊界，讓中央形狀呼吸|concentrate ornament along borders and let central shapes breathe|裝飾標籤與海報

圖形與裝飾|Graphic & decorative art|deco|放射階梯裝飾|Stepped radial ornament|以階梯、扇面和金屬細線建立整齊的鏡射秩序|build orderly mirror symmetry using steps, segmented fans and metallic fine lines|大型平面只保留少數高反差幾何細節|preserve a few high-contrast geometric incidents across large flat surfaces|門牌與戲劇化標誌構圖

圖形與裝飾|Graphic & decorative art|blueprint|技術藍圖|Technical blueprint illustration|像製圖般配置等線寬輪廓、隱線和結構剖切|lay out consistent-width outlines, hidden edges and section cuts like a technical drawing|背景用深藍低對比網格，不加入可見數字|use a low-contrast deep blue grid without visible numerals|產品結構與物件拆解

圖形與裝飾|Graphic & decorative art|stained-glass|彩色鉛條玻璃|Leaded stained glass|以深色鉛條框住半透明玻璃色片，讓透射光分布不均|frame translucent colored panes with dark lead strips and distribute transmitted light unevenly|次要區域細分少，主要區域加小片引導視線|use fewer subdivisions in secondary regions and small panes at focus|光色裝飾與框架構圖

圖形與裝飾|Graphic & decorative art|optical|重複線條視錯覺|Optical line modulation|用週期線條增減曲率與密度，讓平面出現可讀的深度錯覺|vary repeating line density and curvature to create readable illusory depth|讓變化集中在一個膨起位置，避免多處衝突|center the deformation on one swell and avoid competing distortions|圖形動感與抽象節奏

數位與空間|Digital & spatial illustration|isometric|斜軸微縮圖|Isometric miniature|採固定斜軸平行投影，將空間拆成清楚可讀的小模塊|break space into modular volumes under a fixed parallel isometric projection|用物件遮擋和單向陰影表示層次，不用消失點|use occlusion and directional shadows instead of vanishing points|地圖、微縮空間與服務流程

數位與空間|Digital & spatial illustration|pixel|有限色像素圖|Limited-palette pixel art|用可見整像素台階畫形，僅在必要處用棋盤抖色|draw with visible integer-pixel steps, using checkerboard dithering sparingly|調色限制避免半透明鋸齒與連續漸層|keep a strict palette without translucent antialiasing or smooth gradients|小型遊戲美術與圖標

數位與空間|Digital & spatial illustration|voxel|方塊體素世界|Voxel-built world|把形體雕為可數方塊，以清楚階梯輪廓表示量體|sculpt objects from countable cubes and show mass in clear stair-stepped silhouettes|讓地面投影與體素方向一致，避免平滑圓角|align shadows with the voxel axes and avoid smoothed bevels|積木式場景與角色造型

數位與空間|Digital & spatial illustration|clay|手捏黏土場景|Hand-shaped clay scene|用鈍圓黏土量體、指印凹痕與簡單接縫建模|model volumes from blunt clay shapes with thumb dents and simple seams|用寬柔光顯出指紋及接縫，而非光滑塑料|reveal fingerprints and seams with a broad soft source rather than shiny plastic|角色、玩具與親和感畫面

數位與空間|Digital & spatial illustration|cel|賽璐珞硬邊分色|Cel-shaded illustration|以固定陰影階和乾淨外輪廓建立手繪賽璐珞感|use a limited set of hard-edged shadow tiers and clean outer contours for cel art|安排二次陰影在轉折面，而非整體炫光|reserve a second shadow tier for turned planes rather than a global glow|動作插畫與故事分鏡

數位與空間|Digital & spatial illustration|wireframe|線框等高雕塑|Wire contour sculpture|以連續三維等高線定義體積，局部網格沿曲率縮密|define volume with spatial contour loops and tighten local mesh along curvature|在交叉處明確給前後線條不同亮度|separate near and far lines by brightness where the structure crosses|空間示意與科技插畫
